requirements.title: Invoice total counts every item as price × quantity
requirements.detail:
The total is the sum of `price * quantity` over the items: one pen bought three times costs
three pens. The demo defect drops the quantity, so every line counts once.

invariants.title: A destructive migration must be marked by a human
invariants.detail: The migration gate is selected only for changes that touch `migrations/`.
